scope: Local fixtures with bundled Supabase SDK, Playwright Chromium, VM clock tests and PGlite; no live database writes or production deployment.

navigation.method: Eight routes, three repeats per mode; switchTab through two animation frames. Timing varies with browser/host scheduling.

focused_browser_checks.name: desktop real SDK login and initial data preparation
desktop module navigation online and offline after preload
repeat payroll reads reuse prepared memory
desktop online logout: no success notice, opaque loading surface, locked private data, SDK request when online
desktop offline logout: no success notice, opaque loading surface, locked private data, SDK request when online
desktop password reauthentication offline retains encrypted draft
phone online logout: no success notice, opaque loading surface, locked private data, SDK request when online
phone offline logout: no success notice, opaque loading surface, locked private data, SDK request when online
phone password reauthentication offline retains encrypted draft

focused_clock_browser_checks: desktop real browser clock, trusted activity, sleep restoration and offline expiry with reauthentication gate
phone real browser clock, trusted activity, sleep restoration and offline expiry with reauthentication gate
server sign-out failure retains a genuine error notice and locks local access

verified: synthetic events and background writes do not reset deadline
Supabase SDK token refresh does not reset deadline
startup, visibility and pageshow check saved deadline
sleep/tab restoration requires reauthentication after expiry
offline password reauthentication retains encrypted work

limitations: Reported one-second production navigation delay was not reproduced with the small local dataset.
Physical devices and live production Supabase sign-out were not tested; desktop/phone browser fixtures use the actual bundled SDK.
No merge into main or production deployment.
